=== ER 的 M:N 关系 -> 中间表 (sqlite 实跑) ===
表结构: enrollment(sid, cid, grade) PRIMARY KEY(sid, cid)
  复合主键 (sid,cid) 天然禁止同一学生重复选同一门课

选课明细 (三表 JOIN):
  sid   sname    cid    title    grade
  S1    Zhang    C1     DB       92
  S1    Zhang    C2     OS       85
  S2    Li       C1     DB       77
  S2    Li       C3     Net      91
  S3    Wang     C3     Net      88
  连接元组数 = 5 (M:N 关系的每一对 (学生,课程) 一行)

  C1     DB       2 人

  重复插入 (S1,C1) -> 被复合主键拦截: UNIQUE constraint failed: enrollment.sid, enrollment.cid

code:
# ER 图 -> 关系模式: M:N 必须落成中间表, 用 sqlite 实跑并验证约束
import sqlite3

con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
cur = con.cursor()
cur.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE student (sid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sname TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE course  (cid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE enrollment (
    sid   TEXT NOT NULL,
    cid   TEXT NOT NULL,
    grade INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (sid, cid),
    FOREIGN KEY (sid) REFERENCES student(sid),
    FOREIGN KEY (cid) REFERENCES course(cid)
);
INSERT INTO student VALUES ('S1','Zhang'),('S2','Li'),('S3','Wang');
INSERT INTO course  VALUES ('C1','DB'),('C2','OS'),('C3','Net');
INSERT INTO enrollment VALUES ('S1','C1',92),('S1','C2',85),('S2','C1',77),('S3','C3',88),('S2','C3',91);
""")

print("=== ER 的 M:N 关系 -> 中间表 (sqlite 实跑) ===")
print("表结构: enrollment(sid, cid, grade) PRIMARY KEY(sid, cid)")
print("  复合主键 (sid,cid) 天然禁止同一学生重复选同一门课")
print()
print("选课明细 (三表 JOIN):")
print("  %-5s %-8s %-6s %-8s %s" % ("sid", "sname", "cid", "title", "grade"))
for r in cur.execute("""
SELECT e.sid, s.sname, e.cid, c.title, e.grade
FROM enrollment e
JOIN student s ON e.sid = s.sid
JOIN course  c ON e.cid = c.cid
ORDER BY e.sid, e.cid
"""):
    print("  %-5s %-8s %-6s %-8s %s" % r)
n = cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment").fetchone()[0]
print("  连接元组数 = %d (M:N 关系的每一对 (学生,课程) 一行)" % n)
print()
print("每门课选课人数 (GROUP BY 验证 N:M 两端基数):")
for r in cur.execute("""
SELECT c.cid, c.title, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM course c JOIN enrollment e ON c.cid = e.cid
GROUP BY c.cid, c.title ORDER BY c.cid
"""):
    print("  %-6s %-8s %d 人" % r)
print()
print("约束验证:")
try:
    cur.execute("INSERT INTO enrollment VALUES ('S1','C1',60)")
    print("  重复插入 (S1,C1) -> 未被拦截 (异常!)")
except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
    print("  重复插入 (S1,C1) -> 被复合主键拦截: %s" % str(e))
try:
    cur.execute("INSERT INTO enrollment VALUES ('S9','C1',60)")
    print("  引用不存在的学生 S9 -> 未被拦截 (异常!)")
except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
    print("  引用不存在的学生 S9 -> 被外键拦截: %s" % str(e))
print("  最终 enrollment 行数 = %d" % cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment").fetchone()[0])
con.close()
